plan.objective: Finish the remaining Audienti decommission work by shipping the current Exo decommission fixes, draining research and retrieval backlog safely, adding outbound dispatch gates and pacing, improving operator visibility, and closing listed P2 risk follow-ups while keeping live sends gated.
acceptanceCriteria: The committed revision contains the decommission-critical queue, visible-total, and related fixes.
Focused decommission tests pass from a clean working tree.
exo agent queue --json shows due research or retrieval work until real backlog drains, with no false zero.
exo agent doctor --json shows the scheduler installed and loaded with no queue blockers.
Bounded agent passes reduce current due research/retrieval tasks through durable Exo writeback.
LinkedIn outbound dispatch cannot bypass ownership, disposition, pacing, rolling caps, warm-up limits, randomized spacing, or target-local send windows.
Operator CLI and UI surfaces show current worker activity, captured counts, waiting reasons, next due times, throughput, and explicit partial reasons.
P2 follow-ups have regression coverage for Gmail canonical variants, held branch visibility, slim next path behavior, targetMap payload storage, and removed unreachable repair paths.
constraints: Keep scheduled send mode at verify or canary until the outbound dispatch gate is complete.
Retrieval and research may drain. Outbound sends may not drain during this plan unless explicitly bounded after the gate is proven.
Do not run blind loops over older WIP items. This plan file is the active work source.
Treat live-send rollout as gated by passing tests, exo agent doctor --json, exo agent queue --json, and one bounded pass.
Current plan audit expected 50 due tasks, but preflight on 2026-06-11T16:37Z showed 84 due, 0 waiting, 0 blockers. Use live queue truth, not the stale count.
nonGoals: Do not promote scheduled send mode beyond verify/canary as part of P0.
Do not implement deferred prospect lifecycle phase B before throughput and safe outbound are stable.
Do not implement WS4 research concurrency before single-worker research drain is stable.

tasks.title: Define outbound dispatch gate contract
tasks.context: Outbound dispatch must have one pre-dispatch gate shared by LinkedIn send handoff and physical transport. The contract must re-check cross-motion ownership, prospect/account disposition, per-account pacing, rolling hourly/daily/weekly caps per connector account and action type, warm-up ceilings, target-local business hours, randomized LinkedIn delays, and inbound-reply exemptions from send windows while still counting budgets.
doneWhen: A single gate API returns allow, wait, or block with visible reason fields.
Tests cover stale cross-motion branch blocked before dispatch.
Tests cover 26th default daily connection request deferred with waitingReason pacing.
Tests cover warm-up account ceiling, Morocco target-local send window, and inbound reply send-window exemption.
outputs: Added a single evaluateOutboundDispatchGate API that returns allow, wait, or block with reasonCode, waitingReason or blockReason, nextDueAt, sender/account context, and optional owner/limit/spacing details.
Integrated the gate into send_message queue construction so blocked sends surface as send_dispatch_blocked blockers and wait decisions remain visible as waiting send tasks.

Gate coverage includes stale cross-motion ownership, inactive disposition, rolling hourly/daily/weekly caps, the 26th default daily connection request, warm-up daily ceilings, target-local send windows, deterministic LinkedIn spacing, and inbound-reply send-window exemption.

tasks.title: Add retrieval scheduling and drain posture
tasks.context: P1 retrieval throughput replaces the single working-hours gate with per-capability scheduling. Gmail retrieval stays available around the clock. LinkedIn retrieval uses humane account-local windows. LinkedIn outbound stays on stricter target-local send windows and pacing. Add drain posture for retrieval and research only, surface fair-share across LinkedIn surfaces, and back off repeat retrieval failures across passes.
doneWhen: Gmail retrieval is due regardless of operator working hours.
LinkedIn retrieval is due only inside account-local humane windows.
LinkedIn sends remain gated by target-local send windows and pacing.
Drain posture applies to retrieval/research lanes but not outbound sends.
Repeat retrieval failures back off across passes and expose blockers instead of hot-looping.
outputs: Added classifyInboundRetrievalWindow so Gmail retrieval is always eligible while LinkedIn retrieval uses a humane account-local 07:00-22:00 window with account metadata overrides for timezone/window policy.
Agent queue now schedules inbound retrieval from the per-capability retrieval window instead of operator working hours, with waitingReason outside_retrieval_window for held LinkedIn retrieval.
Inbound automation status and health warnings now compute next due times against the same retrieval window while preserving failed-retrieval backoff and rollout blockers.
Connection repair UI copy now names the next allowed retrieval window instead of working hours.
Tests cover Gmail retrieval after operator hours, LinkedIn retrieval inside the humane window after operator hours, and LinkedIn retrieval deferred outside the humane window.
